title: Road Ahead for Indian Auto Industry – Short Term vis-à-vis Long Term Recovery

summary.about: Evaluates whether improving monthly vehicle sales represented a durable recovery after India’s lockdown.
summary.audience: Automotive executives, investors and industrial policymakers.
summary.method: Compares month-on-month, year-on-year and quarterly sales across major two- and four-wheeler manufacturers. The analysis is interpreted through the relevant sectoral transmission mechanisms and implementation constraints.
summary.insights: Sequential sales showed returning confidence, but weak annual comparisons indicated that full long-term recovery remained distant. The conclusion is conditional on the evidence base and assumptions described in the study.
